subtitle: The Toll Road
briefing: The road climbs between wooded ridges. Beyond the trees lie the settlements taken by the dead. The patrol needs a foothold before it can follow the trail farther east. Scout the woods and find somewhere to gather your people. The Bellwarden's ritual is approaching. You must leave by the end of round 30.
hints: Keep the patrol together while you scout.
Claim the camp so there’s somewhere to muster.

intro.speaker: Ivo
intro.text: Firm ground, trees to break the wind, and a view of the approaches. We could make a camp here.

intro.speaker: Nera
intro.text: A place to fall back to. Good. Check the woods before we settle in.

victory.speaker: Nera
victory.text: The message is on its way to the ferry. Now we find where that column went.

victory.speaker: Ivo
victory.text: East, then. I’ll watch the road.

debrief: The rescued villagers remain in the hidden village. A runner carries word back to the crossing while the patrol follows the prisoner road east.
